title: Austrian Government Ernst Mach Grant
field: Natural Sciences, Technical Sciences, Medicine, Agriculture, Humanities, Social Sciences, Arts
description: The Ernst Mach Grant is funded by the Austrian Federal Ministry of Education, Science and Research. It supports students and researchers from non-European developing countries to study or conduct research at Austrian universities of applied sciences.
amount: Monthly grant of €1,150 for graduates, €1,350 for PhD holders; travel cost subsidy; accommodation support; health insurance
university: Various Austrian Universities of Applied Sciences
eligibility: Students and researchers from developing countries; maximum age 35 for Master, 40 for PhD, 45 for Postdoctoral; strong academic record
source: Austrian Federal Ministry of Education, Science and Research

title: Ghent University Top-Up Grant for International Students
field: Engineering, Science, Bioscience, Economics, Law, Psychology, Arts, Medicine
description: Ghent University provides Top-Up Grants to talented international students from developing countries who wish to pursue a master's program. This grant supplements the VLIR-UOS scholarship or can be applied independently.
amount: Monthly allowance of €1,000 for living expenses plus tuition fee reduction; total support up to €24,000 per year
eligibility: International students from developing countries; offer of admission to Ghent University master's program; strong academic background

title: University of Helsinki International Scholarship
field: Science, Arts, Social Sciences, Law, Medicine, Agriculture, Education, Technology
description: The University of Helsinki Scholarship provides tuition fee waivers and living cost support for talented international students from outside the EU/EEA. Helsinki is Finland's oldest and largest university with a strong research focus.
amount: Full tuition fee waiver plus €5,000 relocation grant; some programs offer additional living cost support
eligibility: Non-EU/EEA international students applying for master's programs; excellent academic record; must meet program-specific requirements

title: Aalto University Excellence Scholarship
field: Engineering, Technology, Business, Design, Architecture, Arts, Science
description: Aalto University Excellence Scholarship recognizes outstanding international students pursuing master's programs at Finland's leading technology and design university. The scholarship promotes academic excellence and innovation.
amount: Full tuition fee waiver (€15,000 per year) for the entire duration of the master's program; possible additional living cost support
eligibility: Non-EU/EEA students with outstanding academic performance; admitted to Aalto University master's program; GMAT/GRE required for some programs

title: University of Oslo International Scholarship
field: Humanities, Social Sciences, Law, Medicine, Science, Education, Theology
description: The University of Oslo offers the Quota Scheme Scholarship for international students from developing countries. Norway's oldest and highest-ranked university provides full financial support for selected master's and PhD programs.
amount: Full tuition coverage, monthly living allowance NOK 13,790, housing support, travel grant, health insurance through National Insurance Scheme
eligibility: Students from eligible developing countries and partnership institutions; strong academic record; admission to University of Oslo program required

title: NTNU Norwegian University of Science and Technology Scholarship
field: Engineering, Natural Sciences, Architecture, Information Technology, Marine Technology, Medicine, Energy
description: NTNU offers tuition-free education and various scholarship opportunities for international students. The university is Norway's primary institution for engineering and technological education and research.
amount: No tuition fees for all students; Quota Scheme provides living costs NOK 13,790 per month, housing, and travel support
university: Norwegian University of Science and Technology
eligibility: International students from eligible countries; strong academic credentials; admission to NTNU program; research background for PhD
source: Norwegian University of Science and Technology

title: University of Barcelona International Scholarship
field: Arts, Science, Medicine, Law, Economics, Engineering, Social Sciences, Humanities
description: The University of Barcelona provides the UB International Scholarship for outstanding international students pursuing postgraduate studies. It is Spain's top-ranked university with a strong international reputation.
amount: Tuition fee waiver up to €3,000 per year; monthly stipend of €800-1,200; accommodation support; Spanish language courses included
eligibility: International students from outside the EU; academic excellence; admission to University of Barcelona postgraduate program; Spanish or Catalan proficiency for some programs

title: University of Lisbon International Scholarship
field: Engineering, Science, Arts, Law, Medicine, Economics, Architecture, Social Sciences
description: The University of Lisbon offers merit-based scholarships for international students through its International Student Support Program. ULisboa is Portugal's largest and most prestigious university.
amount: Tuition fee reduction of 50% to 100%; monthly stipend of €500-€900; research support for PhD candidates; Portuguese language course included
eligibility: International students from non-EU countries; excellent academic record; admission to University of Lisbon; Portuguese proficiency preferred but not mandatory

title: University of Tartu International Scholarship
field: Technology, Computer Science, International Relations, Medicine, Business, Law, Semiotics, Science
description: The University of Tartu offers scholarships for international students at all degree levels. Estonia's national university is one of the oldest in Northern Europe and a leader in digital innovation and e-governance research.
amount: Bachelor and Master: full tuition fee waiver; PhD: full funding with monthly stipend of €1,600; travel grants; Dora Plus scholarship available
eligibility: International students with outstanding academic achievement; admission to University of Tartu; motivation letter; English proficiency

title: University of Latvia International Scholarship
field: Science, Engineering, Medicine, Business, Humanities, Social Sciences, Law, Computer Science
description: The University of Latvia provides scholarships through the Latvian State Scholarship Program for international students. The program supports academic mobility and attracts talented students to the Baltic region.
amount: Monthly stipend of €500-€700; tuition fee waiver for up to 100%; accommodation support; Latvian language courses provided
eligibility: International students from eligible countries; strong academic background; admission to University of Latvia program; some programs require specific prerequisites

title: Vilnius University International Scholarship
field: Science, Medicine, Law, Humanities, Business, IT, International Relations, Arts
description: Vilnius University offers the Lithuanian State Scholarship for international students. As Lithuania's oldest and largest university, it provides quality education in the heart of the Baltic region.
amount: Full tuition fee waiver; monthly stipend of €550; accommodation subsidy; Lithuanian language course included; travel allowance
eligibility: International students with excellent academic records; admission to Vilnius University; motivation and recommendation letters required

title: University of Cape Town International Scholarship
field: Engineering, Medicine, Science, Commerce, Law, Humanities, Social Sciences, African Studies
description: The University of Cape Town offers the UCT International Scholarship for outstanding students from across Africa and beyond. UCT is Africa's leading university with a strong focus on research addressing continental challenges.
amount: Full tuition fee waiver; monthly stipend of ZAR 12,000-15,000; accommodation in university residence; research funding; health insurance
eligibility: International students, particularly from African countries; outstanding academic achievement; admission to UCT; research proposal for postgraduate programs

title: Stellenbosch University International Scholarship
field: Agriculture, Engineering, Science, Medicine, Business, Law, Arts, African Studies
description: Stellenbosch University provides the SU International Scholarship for postgraduate students from across Africa and the world. It is one of South Africa's leading research-intensive universities located in the Western Cape winelands.
amount: Full tuition waiver; monthly stipend ZAR 10,000-13,000; housing allowance; research and conference travel support; medical aid contribution
eligibility: International postgraduate students; strong academic background; admission to Stellenbosch University; research alignment with university priorities

title: Al-Azhar University International Scholarship
field: Islamic Studies, Arabic Language, Medicine, Engineering, Science, Law, Education, Agriculture
description: Al-Azhar University, one of the world's oldest universities, offers scholarships to international students to study Islamic sciences and secular disciplines. The scholarship promotes Islamic education and cultural exchange.
amount: Full tuition fee waiver; monthly stipend EGP 3,000-5,000; accommodation in Al-Azhar dormitories; Arabic language training; health services
eligibility: International Muslim students; secondary school certificate or bachelor's degree; medical fitness; recommendation from Islamic organization or embassy

title: Mohammed VI Polytechnic University International Scholarship
field: Engineering, Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Renewable Energy, Agriculture, Business, Chemistry, Materials Science
description: Mohammed VI Polytechnic University (UM6P) offers full scholarships to outstanding international students. Located in Benguerir, UM6P is a world-class research university focused on innovation and sustainable development in Africa.
amount: Full tuition waiver; monthly stipend MAD 8,000-12,000; on-campus accommodation; health insurance; research and travel grants; laptop provided
eligibility: International students with strong academic records; bachelor's or master's degree; research proposal for PhD; commitment to African development

title: KAUST Gifted Student Program Scholarship
field: Engineering, Computer Science, Bioscience, Energy, Environmental Science, Mathematics, Chemistry, Earth Science
description: The King Abdullah University of Science and Technology Gifted Student Program provides full scholarships for exceptional international students. KAUST is a world-class graduate research university on the Red Sea coast.
amount: Full tuition support; annual living stipend USD 25,000-30,000; free housing; medical and dental coverage; relocation support; annual travel allowance
university: King Abdullah University of Science and Technology
eligibility: International students with outstanding academic records; bachelor's degree for Master, master's for PhD; strong research background; TOEFL/IELTS scores required
source: King Abdullah University of Science and Technology

title: University of Jordan International Scholarship
field: Medicine, Engineering, Science, Arts, Business, Islamic Studies, Law, Agriculture, IT
description: The University of Jordan provides scholarships for international students through its International Student Program. As Jordan's oldest and largest university, it offers quality education in the heart of the Middle East.
amount: Tuition fee waiver up to 100%; monthly stipend JOD 200-350; accommodation support; Arabic language training for non-native speakers; health insurance
eligibility: International students from Arab and Islamic countries preferred; strong academic record; admission to University of Jordan; recommendation from cultural attaché or embassy

title: IsDB Scholarship Program for Muslim Communities
field: Medicine, Engineering, Agriculture, IT, Science, Economics, Education, Islamic Studies
description: The Islamic Development Bank Scholarship Program supports students from Muslim communities in non-member countries to pursue higher education. It aims to develop human capital and promote socio-economic development in Muslim communities worldwide.
amount: Full tuition fee coverage; monthly living allowance; medical insurance; round-trip airfare; thesis preparation allowance; conference attendance support
university: Top Universities in IsDB Member Countries and Worldwide
eligibility: Students from Muslim communities in non-IsDB member countries; must meet academic and age requirements; commitment to serve community after graduation
